instruction: Inspect guih14_robot_baseplate_seed.dxf in LibreCAD. Launch LibreCAD from `/usr/bin/librecad` before opening `guih14_robot_baseplate_seed.dxf`. Complete the hard robot baseplate. Draw BASE square (0,0)-(320,320), CUT circle center (160,160) radius 35, twelve HOLE circles radius 5 on a radius-120 bolt circle centered at (160,160) every 30 degrees starting at (280,160), four horizontal SLOTs 50 x 12 centered at (80,80), (240,80), (80,240), and (240,240), CENTER axes (0,160)-(320,160) and (160,0)-(160,320), DATUM target circles radius 8 at (0,160), (160,0), and (320,160), and notes ROBOT BASE RB-320, 12X Ø10 ON Ø240 B.C., 4X SLOT 50X12, and DATUM A/B/C. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih14_robot_baseplate_completed.dxf.
